title: No exit here
hypothesis: Saying, when a press or navigate_to meets a map edge on a side with no map connection, that there is no way off the map there and which ways there are (e046 invented "Oldale's east exit to Petalburg" at s18744 and "Route 103's north exit to Rustboro" at s17437; deb4 and 9439 walked to Littleroot's south edge for a "ROUTE116" exit that does not exist), makes models stop retrying invented exits, so fewer calls go to edges with no connection and more runs reach PETALBURG WOODS, in fewer turns.
